AgentModelCharacteristics.description: The agent's context policy, layered over what the model declares.
AgentModelCharacteristics.title: AgentModelCharacteristics

AgentOverride.description:
What one run changes of its revision's configuration; an omitted or null field keeps the revision's.

`toolsets` replaces whole toolsets; `retries` and each subagent edge replace the fields they set, and a null
edge removes it; every other field replaces the revision's value.
AgentOverride.title: AgentOverride

AgentReviewer.description: The model reviewing calls whose permission is `review`, selected by model key.
AgentReviewer.title: AgentReviewer

ChildEnvironmentPolicy.description: What a child run mounts: no environment, the parent's, or a new one from `template_id`.
ChildEnvironmentPolicy.title: ChildEnvironmentPolicy

ClientToolDefinition.description: Portable model guidance for one externally executed client tool.
ClientToolDefinition.title: ClientToolDefinition

ConnectionSelection.description: An agent's selected tools and permissions.
ConnectionSelection.title: ConnectionSelection

ContentRef.description: An immutable Host-owned value, loaded through that Host's authorized content API.
ContentRef.title: ContentRef

Delta.description: One raw AG-UI event, sequenced by the producer and correlated to its display item.
Delta.title: Delta

DisplayContinuation.description: Parsing state at a semantic cut; Host paging may retire only immutable items.
DisplayContinuation.title: DisplayContinuation

EnvironmentAction.description: Exact authorization values in the locked first-party catalog.
EnvironmentAction.title: EnvironmentAction

EnvironmentVariables.description: Default variables for Agent commands. Ordinary readable configuration, not secret storage. Command variables override these defaults.

ExecutionOverride.description: Sparse choices: null inherits; Thread PATCH distinguishes omission from null.
ExecutionOverride.title: ExecutionOverride

Failed.description: An explicit external tool failure, including an intentional unanswered question.
Failed.title: Failed

FragmentState.description: Incomplete custom payloads, not a journal of completed events.
FragmentState.title: FragmentState

FrozenMemoryMount.description: Host-resolved Space identity and roots, never accepted from a mount request.
FrozenMemoryMount.title: FrozenMemoryMount

Gap.description: Output of a followed run was lost: its deltas are held until an `items` frame repairs it.
Gap.title: Gap

IsolatedSkillSync.description: Reuse immutable package directories, with a soft count budget.
IsolatedSkillSync.title: IsolatedSkillSync

ItemRef.description: The item a live event changed, and its state after the event.
ItemRef.title: ItemRef

MediaUnderstandingSelection.description: The model, by key, describing each media kind a model cannot read; a kind without one is unavailable.
MediaUnderstandingSelection.title: MediaUnderstandingSelection

MemoryMount.description:
A memory under the name the model addresses it by, exposing the tools its access allows. `recall` lets a
record memory recall records into each run's first input; file memories ignore it.
MemoryMount.title: MemoryMount

MemorySource.description: One automatic delivery in this Run; content remains in the memory or execution archive.
MemorySource.title: MemorySource

ObserverContinuation.description: Native conversion cursors required to resume mid-part, without raw history.
ObserverContinuation.title: ObserverContinuation

OccurrenceExecution.description: Current execution observations alongside the durable occurrence completion facts.
OccurrenceExecution.title: OccurrenceExecution

OutputSpec.description:
Plain text without a schema, one structured output, or at least two named variants.

`resources` are the schemas `$ref`s may name besides the schema's own definitions.
OutputSpec.title: OutputSpec

Pending.description: Public projection; complete native requests and private metadata stay in the checkpoint.
Pending.title: Pending

PluginSelection.description: One instance of a Harness plugin factory the deployment installed.
PluginSelection.title: PluginSelection

Resume.description: The complete result batch, submitted and stored on the successor without omission defaults.
Resume.title: Resume

Returned.description: A JSON tool result. Built-in question values are validated by the Harness.
Returned.title: Returned

RunConfiguration.description:
An accepted snapshot, independent of Agent definitions and Capability configuration.

Consumers explicitly opt into namespaced extensions and own their validation.
Extension lookups return detached values, not mutable shared state.

allowed_hosts.description: Allowed normalized hostnames/IP literals or regex:<Python pattern> rules matched against the entire normalized hostname. Null is unrestricted; an empty array denies all.
allowed_hosts.title: Allowed Hosts

RunConfiguration.title: RunConfiguration

RunOptions.description: What a message may choose for the run it starts. A steer joins a run with the defaults or equal options.
RunOptions.title: RunOptions

RunSnapshot.description:
A run's committed items from ordinal `first` on. The receiver deletes the items it holds from `first` on and
inserts these; earlier items are final. `complete` marks the run's final display.
RunSnapshot.title: RunSnapshot

SharedSkillSync.description: Publish mutable conventional names; the last completed publication wins.
SharedSkillSync.title: SharedSkillSync

SubagentOverride.description: Replaces the fields it sets of an edge; an edge the revision lacks sets at least `agent_id`.
SubagentOverride.title: SubagentOverride

ThreadState.description: A thread's current state: the thread, the runs its pointers name and its open inbox entries.
ThreadState.title: ThreadState

ToolReviewRule.description: A matching rule overrides the supplied fields of the global policy.
ToolReviewRule.title: ToolReviewRule

ToolSearch.description: Presentation of already-selected sources, composed by Harness once per agent.
ToolSearch.title: ToolSearch

ToolSearchConfig.description: Names and bounded discovery settings for one Agent's proxy surface.
ToolSearchConfig.title: ProxyToolSearchConfig

UsageLimits.description:
Limits on model usage.

The request count is tracked by Pydantic AI, and the request limit is checked at the start of each step of the
agent loop. Token counts are provided in responses from the model, and the token limits are checked after each response.

Each of the limits can be set to `None` to disable that limit.
UsageLimits.title: UsageLimits

_Arguments.description: A tool-call part's streamed arguments so far and the one observation item that holds them.
_Arguments.title: _Arguments
